newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: NATO's Solana to tour Central Asia mid-March.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Solana to tour Central Asia mid-March.

text.p: NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana will kick off a tour of the former Soviet republics of Central Asia on March 10 in Kazakhstan, the Kazakh foreign ministry said on Friday.
"The Secretary-General will arrive on March 10," a ministry spokesman said. "He will meet (President Nursultan) Nazarbayev and defence officials," he said.

The foreign ministry in neighbouring Kyrgyzstan confirmed Solana would visit the capital Bishkek from March 11-12. Russia's Interfax news agency said Solana would visit the Uzbek capital Tashkent on March 12.

Officials said Solana would discuss the three republics' involvement in NATO's "Partnership for Peace" programme, which will include 10 days of joint peacekeeping exercises with NATO in September in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.
The visit comes as Russia and NATO spar over the Western defence alliance's plans to expand eastwards to admit former Communist countries into the organisation.
Solana's visit to the Transcaucasus republics on Russia's southern flank earlier this month prompted a stream of invective from the Kremlin.
